import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x,y = np.loadtxt("bacteria.csv",delimiter=",",unpack=True)

if np.any(y<=0):
    raise ValueError("Counts must be positive")

yf = np.exp(log_initial+rate*xf)

fig, ax = plt.subplots()

ax.plot(x,y,"o",label="Observations")
ax.plot(xf,yf,"r--",label="Exponential fit")

ax.set_yscale("log")

ax.set(xlabel="Time [sec]",ylabel="Bacteria count",title="Bacteria Growth")
ax.legend()

fig.tight_layout()

fig.savefig("practice.png", dpi=160)

plt.show()

check: len(x)==10 and rate>0 and len(xf)==300 and np.all(yf>0)

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x,y = np.loadtxt("bacteria.csv",delimiter=",",unpack=True)

if np.any(y<=0):
    raise ValueError("Counts must be positive")

rate,log_initial = np.polyfit(x,np.log(y),1)

xf = np.linspace(x.min(),x.max(),300)
yf = np.exp(log_initial+rate*xf)

fig, ax = plt.subplots()

ax.plot(x,y,"o",label="Observations")
ax.plot(xf,yf,"r--",label="Exponential fit")

ax.set_yscale("log")

ax.set(xlabel="Time [sec]",ylabel="Bacteria count",title="Bacteria Growth")
ax.legend()

fig.tight_layout()

fig.savefig("practice.png", dpi=160)

plt.show()

from math import pi, sin, cos, asin, acos, radians, degrees, sqrt, hypot, log

def clock_to_minutes(text):
    hour, minute = map(int,text.split(":"))
    return 60*hour+minute

t1 = clock_to_minutes(input("Time 1 HH:MM: "))

k = -log((T2-Ts)/(T1-Ts))/elapsed

before = log((98.6-Ts)/(T1-Ts))/k

death = (t1-round(before)) % 1440

hour, minute = divmod(death,60)

print(f"{hour:02d}:{minute:02d}")
